title: 第5章 第一次亮相第6章 开始抽奖
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 第二日早朝，萧鼎锋坐在勤政殿上方，看着下方，最前面站着的是四位皇子，除去三皇子在戍边，而六皇子无心太子之位，刚刚年满十八就出宫，做了个逍遥王爷，开始了经商，每个年满十八岁的成年皇子都会上朝听政，下朝后，萧鼎锋也会在御书房内对几位皇子进行问政考核，算是在培养接班人的一种考核，而此时，在四位皇子的旁边又出现了一位，也就是说太子之位的争夺又要多一人了，几位皇子也是在打量突然出现的萧风，而萧风本人却一动不动地站在旁边。
几位皇子相互看了一眼，对这个新出现的人没有任何印象，只有大皇子若有所思地在想些什么，一瞬间他突然想起了什么，然后猛然盯着萧风，是那位的儿子！大皇子，心中大惊，虽然表面上看着波澜不惊，但是内心早已是波涛汹涌了，不行，散了朝一定要和母亲还有舅舅他们商议一下对策。
萧鼎锋像是什么也没有发生一样，处理起今天的政务，各部也开始向他禀明需要他决断的事情，然后进行政务讨论，当各部将今天所需处理的事情都处理完后，萧鼎锋开口道：“今天诸位也发现了，有一位新的皇子出现在了这朝堂之上，朕向大家介绍一下，他是朕的七儿子，萧风。”
朝堂轰的一下炸开了，几位皇子则是面面相觑，不知道该说些什么，因为除了几个年长点的皇子，有几个皇子根本不知道有七皇子，而且宫中所有人都不会谈及七皇子，不知道为何父皇突然将这个消息直接在所有人面前说出来，不行，等散朝之后，一定要和各自的母妃沟通一下，此时萧风的出现，肯定不是那么简单的。
在场的大臣，除了几大世家的人以外，大部分都是新上任的，也都不知道陛下还有七皇子，在文臣最前面的是丞相呼延墨岩并没有什么反应，因为昨日他便已经见过了，而在武将最前面的是护国将军萧鼎南，是萧鼎锋的亲兄弟，当年也是萧鼎锋成功问鼎皇位的功臣之一，他则是充满欣喜地看着萧风，毕竟他很清楚，萧鼎锋对白飞雪的爱，爱屋及乌，肯定也是很看重萧风的。
“肃静，萧风还有一个月就年满十八岁了，朕现在封萧风为汉王，允许开府，命人修建汉王府，这几日便先在之前告老还乡的王尚书府中暂住，另外赏赐白银十万两，工部，尽快赶制汉王府，礼部，准备一个月后的封王典礼，通知老三，让他回来一趟，最近一个月，汉王可以不用上朝，安心地准备封王，好了，退朝吧。”随着萧鼎锋的话落，萧鼎锋和刘雨离开了勤政殿。
满朝的皇子和大臣连一句阻拦的话，都没有办法说，而几位皇子看着萧风，只是点了点头，然后向御书房走去，众大臣看着萧风，也没有人上来搭话，也都三三两两地离开了，萧鼎南走上来拍了拍萧风的肩膀，什么也没说也离去了，萧风显然是不认识这个魁梧的将军，只是纳闷，为什么别人都不理他，而他走上来拍了拍我的肩膀，况且，臣子应该不会对皇子这样无礼吧。
正当他纳闷的时候，只见一老者过来，像是看出了他的疑惑，开口说道：“汉王殿下，刚刚那个是陛下的亲弟弟，是你的叔叔，也是护国将军萧鼎南。”
原来如此，我就说谁敢当面在朝堂上对皇子如此无礼。
“多谢告知，不知您是？”
“老朽是当朝丞相，呼延墨岩。”
“见过丞相大人。”
呼延墨岩摆了摆手，说：“汉王殿下，您该去御书房了，几位皇子每次下朝之后都必须去御书房，陛下会对他们进行考核的，既然您也要开府，自然也是要去一趟的。”
“好的，多谢丞相告知，那我就先去了。”
萧风转身便走出了勤政殿，跟着在外等候的小太监，向御书房走去。
当他进入御书房中，看到了其他四位皇子，但是原主对他们的记忆几乎为零，因为从小他就在听轩小筑中，六岁之后更是没有踏出过，所以也根本不认识这些所谓的哥哥。
看着萧风走进来，萧鼎锋也没有过多的介绍，只是对其他四位皇子提问了刚刚在早朝时候各部提出的问题，进行了提问，过了大约一个时辰，萧鼎锋问完之后，便让四位皇子离开了，殿内只剩下了萧鼎锋、刘雨还有萧风，这时萧鼎锋说：“今天并没有介绍你的几位哥哥，你是不是觉得很奇怪？”
“回父皇，父皇这样做肯定是有自己的道理的，儿臣不敢瞎猜。”
萧鼎锋听着萧风的回答，没有继续说就那个问题说下去，而是说：“让刘雨带着你去王尚书之前的府邸吧，王尚书告老还乡，府邸便空置了下来，你先临时住在哪，佣人的话刘雨会给你安排，等你有了自己的人，告诉刘雨，让他再安排，至于赏赐也一并带过去，这一个月，算是朕对你的考验，你要是连这一个月都扛不住，也就不会有一个月后的封王典礼了。”
“是，儿臣明白，那儿臣先告退了。”
随后萧风跟着刘雨去接上了小丫头，向着宫外驶去。
在马车内，小丫头紧靠在萧风身边，小脑袋探出窗外看着街边的情景，而萧风也是在透过小窗，看着这个陌生的世界，刘雨突然开口道：
“汉王殿下，王尚书的府邸，是之前陛下赏赐的，而在王尚书在十天前告老还乡之时，那座府邸便空了下来，里面还是很好的，至于佣人，早朝的时候，陛下让奴才已经安排人去打扫了，等一个月后汉王府修建完成后，您再从王尚书府邸搬过去，这期间，奴才会安排人过来教您一些礼仪，虽然封王的典礼不是很隆重，但是这也是关系到皇家脸面的事情，所以马虎不得。”
“嗯，本王知道了，有劳刘公公费心了。”
马车停到了一处府邸前，萧风下车后看着这座大院，有点像前世的那种晋商大院，但是比起那个大院，这个显得更加有气势，门口已经有侍卫和佣人在等着萧风到来了。

content_en:
On the morning of the next morning, Xiao Dingfeng sat above the Qinzheng Hall and looked down. The four princes standing at the front were the third prince who was guarding the border. The sixth prince had no intention of being the prince. He left the palace just after he turned eighteen and became a free prince and started doing business. Every adult prince who is over eighteen years old will go to court to listen to politics. After going to court, Xiao Ding Feng would also conduct political assessments on several princes in the imperial study room, which was regarded as a kind of assessment to train successors. At this time, another prince appeared next to the four princes, which meant that there was one more person competing for the crown prince's position. Several princes were also sizing up Xiao Feng who suddenly appeared, but Xiao Feng himself stood motionless beside him.
Several princes glanced at each other. They had no impression of this new person. Only the eldest prince was thinking about something thoughtfully. For a moment, he suddenly remembered something, and then stared at Xiao Feng suddenly. He was that son! The eldest prince was shocked in his heart. Although he looked calm on the surface, his heart was already in turmoil. No, he must discuss countermeasures with his mother and uncle after the court was over.
Xiao Dingfeng acted as if nothing had happened. He dealt with today's government affairs. Each department also began to inform him of the matters that needed his decision, and then held government affairs discussions. After each department had dealt with all the matters that needed to be dealt with today, Xiao Dingfeng said, "You have also discovered today that a new prince has appeared in this court. Let me introduce him to you. He is my seventh son, Xiao Feng."
The court exploded with a bang, and several princes looked at each other, not knowing what to say, because except for a few older princes, some princes did not know that there was a seventh prince, and no one in the palace would talk about the seventh prince. I don't know why the father suddenly said the news directly in front of everyone. No, after the court was over, they must communicate with their respective mothers and concubines. The appearance of Xiao Feng at this time is definitely not that simple.
Most of the ministers present, except for people from a few big families, were newly appointed, and they did not know that His Majesty and the Seventh Prince were there. The one at the front of the civil servants was Prime Minister Huyan Moyan, who had no reaction because he had already seen it yesterday, and the one at the front of the generals was It was Xiao Dingnan, the general who protected the country, Xiao Dingfeng's brother, and one of the heroes who made Xiao Dingfeng successfully aspire to the throne. He looked at Xiao Feng with joy. After all, he knew very well that Xiao Dingfeng's love for Bai Feixue was so great that he must also think highly of Xiao Feng.
"Silence, Xiao Feng will be eighteen years old in one month. I now make Xiao Feng the King of Han, allow him to open a palace, and order people to build the Han Palace. In the past few days, he will stay temporarily in the palace of Wang Shangshu, who retired from old age and returned to his hometown. In addition, he will reward one hundred thousand taels of silver. The Ministry of Industry will rush to build the Han Palace as soon as possible. The government, the Ministry of Rites, is preparing for the king-conferment ceremony in one month. Notify Lao San and ask him to come back. In the next month, the King of Han will not have to go to court and prepare to be king with peace of mind. Okay, let's retreat from the court." As Xiao Dingfeng finished his words, Xiao Dingfeng and Liu Yu left the Qinzheng Hall.
All the princes and ministers in the dynasty could not even say a word to stop him. However, several princes looked at Xiao Feng, just nodded, and then walked to the imperial study. The ministers looked at Xiao Feng, but no one came up to talk to him, and they all left in twos and threes. Xiao Dingnan walked up I came and patted Xiao Feng on the shoulder and left without saying anything. Xiao Feng obviously didn't know this burly general and was just wondering why others ignored him, but he came up and patted me on the shoulder. Besides, the ministers should not be so rude to the prince.
Just when he was wondering, he saw an old man coming over. As if he saw his doubts, he said, "Your Highness, the King of Han, that man just now is your Majesty's younger brother, your uncle, and the general who protects the country, Xiao Dingnan."
That's it, let me tell you who dares to be so rude to the prince in front of the court.
"Thanks for letting me know, who are you?"
"The old man is the prime minister of the current dynasty, Huyan Moyan."
"I have met the Prime Minister."
Huyan Moyan waved his hand and said: "His Royal Highness, it's time for you to go to the imperial study. The princes must go to the imperial study every time after going to court. Your Majesty will conduct assessments on them. Since you also want to open a palace, you will naturally go there."
"Okay, thank you Prime Minister for informing me, I will go first."
Xiao Feng turned around and walked out of Qinzheng Hall, followed the little eunuch waiting outside, and walked to the imperial study.
When he entered the Imperial Study Room, he saw the other four princes, but the original owner had almost zero memory of them, because he had been in Tingxuan Xiaozhu since he was a child, and had never stepped out after he was six years old, so he did not know these so-called brothers at all.
Seeing Xiao Feng walk in, Xiao Dingfeng did not introduce too much. He just asked the other four princes the questions that had just been raised by the ministries in the morning. After about an hour, Xiao Dingfeng asked the four princes to leave. Only Xiao Dingfeng, Liu Yu and Xiao Feng were left in the palace. At this time, Xiao Dingfeng said: "I didn't introduce your brothers today. Do you think it's strange?"
"Back to my father, my father must have his own reasons for doing this. I don't dare to make blind guesses."
Xiao Dingfeng listened to Xiao Feng's answer and did not continue to talk about that question, but said: "Let Liu Yu take you to Wang Shangshu's former mansion. Wang Shangshu retired and returned to his hometown, so the mansion became vacant. Where will you live temporarily first? Liu Yu will be the servant I'll arrange it for you. When you have someone of your own, tell Liu Yu and let him make arrangements. As for the reward, he will also take it with him. This month is my test for you. If you can't bear it for this month, there will be no king ceremony in one month. "
"Yes, I understand. I will retire first."
Then Xiao Feng followed Liu Yu to pick up the little girl and drove out of the palace.
In the carriage, the little girl was close to Xiao Feng, with her little head sticking out of the window to look at the scene on the street. Xiao Feng was also looking at this strange world through the small window. Liu Yu suddenly said:
"Your Highness the King of Han, Wang Shangshu's mansion was a reward from His Majesty. When Wang Shangshu retired and returned to his hometown ten days ago, the mansion was empty, and it was still very good inside. As for the servants, during the morning court, His Majesty asked his servants to arrange for people to clean it. After the construction of the Han Palace is completed in one month, you can move there from Wang Shangshu's residence. During this period, my servant will arrange for someone to come over and teach you some etiquette. Although the ceremony of conferring the title of king is not very grand, it is also a matter of honor for the royal family, so you cannot be careless. "
"Well, I understand. I'd like to thank Eunuch Liu for your troubles."
The carriage stopped in front of a mansion. After Xiao Feng got off the car, he looked at the compound. It looked a bit like the Shanxi merchant compound in his previous life, but compared to that compound, this one looked more imposing. There were already guards and servants at the door waiting for Xiao Feng's arrival.
